newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee climbs to 35.77 vs dlr, RBI abstains.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee climbs to 35.77 vs dlr, RBI abstains.

text.p: The Indian spot rupee climbed to 35.77 against the dollar on Monday compared with the opening level of 35.78/79, dealers said.
"This was expected if RBI did not intervene," a dealer said, referring to Reserve Bank of India (RBI)'s recent dollar purchases to arrest the rupee's appreciation.
Dealers said exporters continued to sell dollars even as demand for dollars fell.
Forward premiums were steady at the earlier low levels.
